title: What the Mirror Shows
description: The tall mirror by the entrance should reflect you. It does not. The figure inside it stands where you stand, wears what you wear, but it is too still - and when you move, it moves a half-beat late. It raises its head. Its eyes are the wrong color. They are the color of nothing.

standard_attack.telegraph: The figure in the glass mimics a gesture you have not made - and you feel it working through you.

special_attacks.telegraph: The figure in the glass has learned you now - it moves before you do, finishing your gestures before your muscles fire, and you feel your own body becoming the echo.
The mirror cracks - not the glass, but the idea of it - and something colorless bleeds through, cold and physical, settling into your bones like frost.

pre_combat_narrative: It presses one hand flat against the glass from the inside. The surface does not give. But you feel it anyway.

visual.alt_text: A tall mirror in a darkened entry hall. The reflection is slightly wrong - a figure that does not quite match, pressing one pale hand to the glass, eyes blank and colorless.
